name: Financial Instrument Quantity 46 Choice
definition: Choice between formats for the quantity of security.

Unit.name: Unit
Unit.definition: Quantity expressed as a number, for example, a number of shares.

FaceAmount.name: Face Amount
FaceAmount.definition: Quantity expressed as an amount representing the face amount, that is, the principal, of a debt instrument.

DigitalTokenUnit.name: Digital Token Unit
DigitalTokenUnit.definition: Quantity of digital tokens expressed as a number, for example, a number of blockchain tokens.

DigitalTokenUnitUsageRule.definition: DigitalTokenUnit format may only be used for instruments identified with a digital token identifier.
